info.title: Earth to Date API
info.description:
Satellite imagery API with clean subprocess architecture.

## View names (the `view` path parameter)

Shared across every endpoint that takes `view` (`/v2/download_aoi`, `/download_shapefile`, tile endpoints, …).

### Sentinel-2 sensors (grammar: `{sensor}_{suffix}`)

`suffix` is either `tci` (true-color RGB) or a band visualization / spectral index — see the two lists below.

| Sensor   | Resolution | Notes                                       |
|----------|------------|---------------------------------------------|
| `s2`     | 10m        | Sentinel-2 native L2A                       |
| `s2r2m`  | 2m         | Reconstructed (fused + deterministic 2× upscale) |
| `sr`     | 50cm       | Super-resolution                            |
| `s2dr`   | 2m         | Derived-Resolution (spectral only)          |
| `s2rr`   | 1m         | Refined Reality (visual only)               |
| `s2r5m`  | 5m         | Derived 5m                                  |

Examples: `s2_tci`, `s2_ndvi`, `s2r2m_tci`, `s2r2m_ndvi`, `sr_tci`, `sr_ndvi`.

### Band visualizations (RGB combinations)

| Suffix          | Bands                  | Purpose                   |
|-----------------|------------------------|---------------------------|
| `_natural`      | Red-Green-Blue         | True color                |
| `_veganalysis`  | NIR-Red-Green          | Vegetation / false-color  |
| `_cropsoil`     | NIR-SWIR-Red           | Crop / soil moisture      |
| `_vegstress`    | SWIR-NIR-Red           | Vegetation stress         |
| `_vegmoisture`  | SWIR-NIR-Green         | Vegetation + moisture     |
| `_geology`      | SWIR-NIR-Blue          | Geological features       |
| `_urban`        | NIR-SWIR-Blue          | Urban / rock              |
| `_water`        | NIR-Red-Blue           | Water bodies              |
| `_watercontent` | SWIR-Red-Green         | Water content             |
| `_atmosphere`   | NIR-Green-Blue         | Atmospheric haze          |
| `_burnscar`     | SWIR2-NIR-Red          | Burn scars                |
| `_snow`         | SWIR-Red-Green         | Snow / ice                |
| `_bathymetric`  | Red-Green-Blue         | Bathymetric (shallow water)|
| `_drought`      | SWIR2-SWIR1-Red        | Drought                   |

### Spectral indices (single-band scalar maps)

| Suffix     | Name / Description                              |
|------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `_ndvi`    | NDVI — Vegetation health                        |
| `_ndwi`    | NDWI — Surface water content                    |
| `_ndmi`    | NDMI — Canopy moisture                          |
| `_savi`    | SAVI — Soil-adjusted vegetation                 |
| `_msavi`   | MSAVI — Modified SAVI                           |
| `_msavi2`  | MSAVI2 — Second-order MSAVI                     |
| `_osavi`   | OSAVI — Optimized SAVI                          |
| `_tsavi`   | TSAVI — Transformed SAVI                        |
| `_evi`     | EVI — Enhanced vegetation                       |
| `_evi2`    | EVI2 — Two-band EVI                             |
| `_nbr`     | NBR — Burn ratio                                |
| `_nbr2`    | NBR2 — Alternative burn ratio                   |
| `_ndre`    | NDRE — Red-edge NDVI                            |
| `_ndre2`   | NDRE variant (different red-edge band)          |
| `_ndre3`   | NDRE variant (different red-edge band)          |
| `_rendvi`  | RENDVI — Red-edge normalized difference         |
| `_cire`    | CIRE — Chlorophyll index, red-edge              |
| `_cire2`   | CIRE variant                                    |
| `_cire3`   | CIRE variant                                    |
| `_cig`     | CIG — Chlorophyll index, green                  |
| `_gndvi`   | GNDVI — Green NDVI                              |
| `_rvi`     | RVI — Ratio VI (NIR/Red)                        |
| `_dvi`     | DVI — Difference VI                             |
| `_rdvi`    | RDVI — Renormalized DVI                         |
| `_pvi`     | PVI — Perpendicular VI                          |
| `_ipvi`    | IPVI — Infrared percentage VI                   |
| `_grvi`    | GRVI — Green-Red VI                             |
| `_sr`      | SR — Simple ratio                               |
| `_sr2`     | SR2 — Simple ratio variant                      |
| `_sipi`    | SIPI — Structure-insensitive pigment            |
| `_ari`     | ARI — Anthocyanin reflectance                   |
| `_cri1`    | CRI1 — Carotenoid reflectance                   |
| `_cri2`    | CRI2 — Carotenoid reflectance variant           |
| `_mcari`   | MCARI — Modified chlorophyll absorption         |
| `_tcari`   | TCARI — Transformed chlorophyll absorption      |
| `_mre`     | MRE — Modified red edge                         |
| `_tre`     | TRE — Transformed red edge                      |
| `_mtvi`    | MTVI — Modified triangular VI                   |
| `_mtvi2`   | MTVI2 — Modified triangular VI 2                |
| `_tvi`     | TVI — Triangular VI                             |
| `_ndsi`    | NDSI — Normalized difference soil               |
| `_bsi`     | BSI — Bare soil                                 |
| `_lai`     | LAI — Leaf area index                           |
| `_cwc`     | CWC — Canopy water content (g/m²)               |
| `_mineralclass` | Mineral classification (permission-gated)  |

### Landsat

| View        | Resolution | Notes                 |
|-------------|------------|-----------------------|
| `ls15_tci`  | 15m        | Pansharpened Landsat  |
| `ls5_tci`   | 5m         | Upscaled from 15m     |

### Combined Sentinel-2 + Landsat

| View        | Resolution | Notes                                                                           |
|-------------|------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `r5m_tci`   | 5m         | Auto-selects S2 (5m derived) or Landsat (5m) per date for best temporal coverage |

### PlanetScope

| View        | Resolution | Notes                        |
|-------------|------------|------------------------------|
| `ps_tci`    | 3m         | Native PlanetScope tile      |
| `psrr_tci`  | 1.9m       | Refined Reality super-res x2 |

### Sentinel-1 SAR

Backscatter intensity (logarithmic, colorized). The `tci` suffix produces an
8-bit display-ready PNG. SAR penetrates clouds and works day/night.

| View          | Resolution | Polarization | Notes                 |
|---------------|------------|--------------|-----------------------|
| `s1vv_tci`    | 10m        | VV           | Native raw Sentinel-1 |
| `s1vh_tci`    | 10m        | VH           | Native raw Sentinel-1 |
| `s1vvsr_tci`  | 1m         | VV           | Super-resolved        |
| `s1vhsr_tci`  | 1m         | VH           | Super-resolved        |

### Night light (VIIRS Black Marble)

| View                       | Resolution | Visualization                                           |
|----------------------------|------------|---------------------------------------------------------|
| `nightlight25m_tci`        | 25m        | Grayscale light intensity                               |
| `nightlight25m_darkened`   | 25m        | Grayscale terrain, darkened where no light              |
| `nightlight25m_lighted`    | 25m        | Grayscale terrain, golden highlights where lights are   |
| `nightlight500m_tci`       | 500m       | Grayscale light intensity                               |
| `nightlight500m_darkened`  | 500m       | Grayscale terrain, darkened where no light              |
| `nightlight500m_lighted`   | 500m       | Grayscale terrain, golden highlights where lights are   |

### High-value analytics & composite indexes (2m reconstructed)

Each of these is a complete high-value analytics product or a complex
composite index built on top of `s2r2m` — not a plain single-band index.

| View                              | Description                                                     |
|-----------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|
| `s2r2m_soilsalinity`              | Soil salinity score (0–100)                                     |
| `s2r2m_soilsalinityclass`         | Soil salinity categorical classes                               |
| `s2r2m_soilsalinityconfidence`    | Model confidence for the soil-salinity estimate                 |
| `s2r2m_biomassgrassland`          | Grassland biomass (kg/ha) — pasture / rangeland focus           |
| `s2r2m_soilmoisture`              | Surface soil-moisture estimate                                  |
| `s2r2m_bgwaterleak`               | Subsurface / background water-leak warnings                     |
| `s2r2m_mineralmap`                | Mineral map (permission-gated)                                  |
| `s2r2m_mineralclass`              | Mineral classification (permission-gated)                       |

### Elevation

| View  | Resolution                             | Notes                                                         |
|-------|----------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
| `dem` | 1m spatial, 0.5–1m vertical accuracy   | ETD's own elevation dataset (not SRTM/ALOS)                   |

### Other views

| View            | Description                                              |
|-----------------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| `flood`         | Flood simulation                                         |
| `s2_scl`        | Sentinel-2 Scene Classification Layer (cloud/shadow/etc) |
| `changes_tci`   | Change detection between two dates                       |

get.description:
Incremental place-name search -> top 10 [{name,lat,lon}]. Uses Photon (komoot, OSM-based)
which is built for autocomplete; Nominatim public forbids autocomplete use and rate-limits.
Current S5P reading(s) + units at a point. gas omitted/'combined' -> all 6 gases.

Low-zoom transparent RGBA pollution OVERLAY tiles (S5P global store).
Separate from /v2 (which stays S2 z12-21). Continental scale: zoom 1-9.

Get satellite tile using tile.py - Main API endpoint

Args:
    view: Product view type (s2_tci, sr_tci, etc.)
    zoom: Tile zoom level (14-18 only)
    tile_x: Tile X coordinate
    tile_y: Tile Y coordinate
    end_date: Target date in YYYY-MM-DD format
    days_back: Days to search backwards
    max_clouds: Maximum cloud coverage percentage
    before: Before date for change detection

Get DEM elevation at a specific lat/lon point.
Returns elevation from all 5 free DEM sources plus the fused result.

Terrain line-of-sight over the BaseDEM2 DSM.

Walks the sight line between two points (each lifted `height` m above the DSM
surface at its location) and returns the first terrain blockage, accounting
for Earth curvature. Returns {"blocked": bool, "blocked_at": {lat,lon,elevation}|null}.

Generate agricultural field history snapshot or serve the HTML interface

Args:
    title: Title for the snapshot (required for image generation)
    bbox: Bounding box as min_lat,min_lon,max_lat,max_lon (required for image generation)
    unit: Time unit (week|month|quarter|year), defaults to quarter
    start: Start date as yyyy-mm-dd, defaults to today
    count: Number of time periods, defaults to 12, max 25
    views: Comma-separated list of views (up to 3), defaults to s2rr_tci

Download Area of Interest - V2 API format

Args:
    bbox_lat_lon: Bounding box as "west,south,east,north"
    date_str: Target date in YYYY-MM-DD format
    days_back: Days to search backwards
    max_clouds: Maximum cloud coverage percentage
    view: Product view type

Get list of available satellite imagery dates for a specific location.

Args:
    lat_lon: Location as 'latitude,longitude'
    view: Product name (e.g., s2_tci, sr_tci)
    date_str: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format
    days_back: Days to search back from end date
    max_clouds: Maximum cloud coverage percentage (0-100)
    source: Data source - "s2" for Sentinel-2 (default) or "ps" for PlanetScope

Returns:
    JSON array of available dates

post.description:
Download a satellite image cropped to an uploaded shapefile.

**Body:** raw shapefile bytes — `.shp`, `.zip` (shapefile or KMZ-as-zip),
`.geojson`, `.kml`, or `.kmz`. LineString geometries are auto-closed
into polygons. Pixels outside the polygon are masked.

Append `_geotiff` to the view to get a GeoTIFF (multi-band, masked with
nodata outside the shape); otherwise a PNG with alpha=0 outside.

Logged AOI usage reflects the polygon area, not the bbox.

For the `view` parameter syntax, see the **View names** section at the
top of this API's documentation.

get.description:
Produce mineral maps for an area of interest.

Returns a zip file containing mineral mapping outputs for each date:
- primary/: tci, geology_composite, sabins, classification, ecai
- secondary/: pca, iron, mixed_iron
